candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Archetype Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a dynamic grid layout highlighting pet personality archetypes and visual behavioral badges.
candidates.why: The adoption step drops to 74.4% conversion and takes a median of 89s; presenting pet traits clearly in a structured grid helps users decide faster.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Archetype
pick_friend.body: Select a companion archetype below to inspect its personality traits and desktop behaviors.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection screen layout into a grid while preserving the required selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage drops to 74.4%; grid redesign addresses decision delay.

candidates.title: New Pet Trait Builder Pre-Screen
candidates.change: Introduces a dedicated companion trait preview screen prior to picking a friend so users configure behavioral temperament upfront.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences substantial friction (74.4% conversion); configuring traits early increases emotional connection before photo asset generation.

new_trait_preview.headline: Configure Pet Companion Temperament
new_trait_preview.body: Adjust your companion's activity levels and vocal interactions before building visual assets.

guard.reason: Adds a new temperament builder screen to the onboarding flow without removing or skipping any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step loses users, but adding a new screen increases total steps.

candidates.title: Waiting Stage Live Desktop Spawn Simulator Flow
candidates.change: Replaces the static waiting view with a live desktop spawn simulator flow that demonstrates pet movements while generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and leads to post-onboarding confusion regarding how the pet functions on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Workspace
waiting.body: Watch your companion test desktop movement while asset compilation finishes.

guard.reason: Replaces the waiting screen layout with an interactive preview while still showing that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Home step has long wait times; interactive simulation keeps users engaged.

candidates.title: Finish Step Quick Control Command Summary
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro view into a full checklist summary explaining essential mouse shortcuts and tray controls.
candidates.why: The finish step drops to 69.7% completion, and multiple support emails noted confusion about controlling, hiding, or summoning pets post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Companion Controls
home_intro.body: Review these essential shortcuts to summon, hide, or chat with your desktop companion anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro view to include control shortcuts, which is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops significantly and support emails explicitly report control confusion.

candidates.title: Story Welcome Interactive Playful Mascot Greeting
candidates.change: Adds an animated mascot spotlight component to the initial story welcome screen to establish immediate visual engagement.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on the choose_path step is high (514s); upfront mascot visuals establish clear product context quickly.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion

guard.reason: Adds a mascot spotlight component to the story screen while retaining its function of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose path already converts at 93.4%, leaving little room for impact.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Cloud Recovery Reassurance
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint messaging on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing companion data will be restored.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating significant sign-in anxiety for returning users.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Access Your Companion Vault
sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs and restores all previously adopted desktop companions.

guard.reason: Adds reassuring hint text to the sign-in screen without violating any onboarding constraints.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in conversion is high, but 8 support emails show user anxiety.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Validation Checklist Component
candidates.change: Displays a dynamic photo quality requirement checklist banner below the photo upload area.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly due to source photo issues.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure single-subject lighting and clear framing for optimal 3D pet asset rendering.

guard.reason: Adds a photo quality checklist to the photo upload screen while keeping the original upload functionality intact.

candidates.score_note: Solves photo validation issues reported in 3 support emails during adoption.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Name Badge Preview
candidates.change: Updates the adoption certificate screen with a prominent companion name input field and official badge component.
candidates.why: Adoption stage completion is low (74.4%); formalizing pet naming strengthens emotional commitment before the render wait.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Assign an official name to finalize your companion registration.

guard.reason: Replaces the official stamp on the adoption certificate with a generic badge that does not read as an official stamp.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Render Progress Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables live completion timers and desktop notification opt-ins on the asset render waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); giving users exact time estimates and desktop notification alerts prevents drop-offs.

guard.reason: Adds completion notifications and progress indicators to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time (201s) at home step with notifications.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Trait & Desktop Tray Guide
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint guidance on how to recall pets via the system tray if they disappear from the desktop screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on screen and 3 about controlling/hiding pets after completing setup.

home_intro.hint: If your companion moves off-screen, right-click the system tray icon to recall or reposition it.

guard.reason: Adds system tray guidance to the home intro screen without modifying anything outside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops to 69.7% and 6 total support emails point to missing controls.
